title: EcoRoute AI — Sustainability Intelligence Platform
description: A full-stack AI-powered sustainability platform that provides data-driven environmental insights, eco-route optimization, transparent reporting, and community collaboration for a greener future.
challenges: The most challenging part was building an AI reasoning engine that accurately analyzes environmental data and generates meaningful sustainability insights in real time. Integrating complex data visualizations (BarChart3, analytics dashboards) while maintaining smooth performance on all devices required careful optimization. Managing authentication with role-based access across a MERN stack and keeping the UI both informative and visually compelling added significant complexity.
improvements: Future plans include adding carbon footprint tracking with real-time IoT sensor integration, a personalized eco-score dashboard for individual users, AI-powered route suggestions that minimize carbon emissions, community leaderboards for sustainability goals, and a mobile app for on-the-go environmental monitoring.

title: Health Care Appointment System
description: A full-stack health care platform where patients can book doctor appointments, manage medical history, and doctors can manage their schedules and patient records.
challenges: The biggest challenge was implementing a real-time appointment booking system that prevents double-booking. Managing doctor availability slots, time zones, and concurrent user sessions required careful state management and server-side validation. Integrating JWT authentication with role-based access for doctors and patients also added complexity.
improvements: Future plans include adding video consultation features using WebRTC, integrating a payment gateway for online consultation fees, implementing automated email/SMS reminders before appointments, and adding a prescription management module with PDF generation.

title: ReadHaus
description: A modern web application featuring intuitive browsing, state management, and a seamless user interface built for performance and user engagement.
challenges: Building a high-performance filtering and search system that handles large datasets without performance degradation was challenging. Implementing a secure flow with data persistence across sessions required careful architecture decisions.
improvements: Future improvements include adding advanced analytics, integrating multiple payment methods, adding user reviews, and building a progressive web app (PWA) for offline browsing.
